title: Deadline and Cover
author: Vesper Coldharbour
blurb: Felix Dravenmoor, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
